## Summary

Added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`**: Creates an entry timestamped at 23:59:59 UTC of the specified date. This leverages the existing `post()` method internally, passing the computed end-of-day datetime.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`**: Filters the ledger to return only entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted by posting time (oldest first). This enables time-based queries on the ledger.

Both methods:
- Follow the existing code style and patterns
- Respect the `timestamps-utc-aware` architectural constraint (always use UTC timezone-aware datetimes)
- Integrate cleanly with the existing API (no breaking changes)
- Pass all existing tests (4/4)
- Have been verified to work correctly with sample data
